# Orbit Student

> Mentor-led AI literacy, entrepreneurship and leadership for ages 8–18. Live cohort classes, student dashboard, portfolio projects and scholarship preparation.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.orbitstudent.com/): Flagship Young CEO programme overview and cohort details
- [Courses](https://www.orbitstudent.com/courses): Curriculum and programme structure
- [Live classes](https://www.orbitstudent.com/live-classes): Schedule, format and mentorship
- [Interactive demo](https://www.orbitstudent.com/demo): Product walkthrough for families
- [AI tools](https://www.orbitstudent.com/tools): Tools available to students
- [FAQ](https://www.orbitstudent.com/faq): Policies, time zones and common questions
- [Resources](https://www.orbitstudent.com/resources): Guides and downloads
- [Blog](https://www.orbitstudent.com/blog): Articles on AI, entrepreneurship and scholarships
- [Contact](https://www.orbitstudent.com/contact): Reach the team
